in_short: The dashboard is kept out of search on purpose, and that is right. Nothing changed for ranking.

One real fault is fixed: while the page checked who was logged in, the footer sat at the top of the screen and then jumped to the bottom. The page's layout-shift score was 0.12, over Google's limit of 0.1. It is now 0.02.
You can now see whether owners come back to their dashboard and which tabs they open. Nothing about the owner is sent.
7 changes are on the branch: 4 technical, 3 tracking. **I left one line of text alone that you should look at: the Offers tab still says 15% off.**

needs_you_intro: Both items are about what the dashboard tells owners. I changed neither.

needs_you.title: The Offers tab still says "Standard first-visit offer: 15% off"
needs_you.detail: On November 2 you removed the 15% offer from the public site, with the rule that offers are agreed with each store and never promised by Rihla. The terms say the same: "Rihla does not set a discount on a restaurant's behalf." Every owner who logs in still reads that their standard offer is 15% off. The diner email template says "15% off" too. Either the dashboard is out of date, or 15% is still the default you agree with each store, in which case the wording should say that it was agreed.
needs_you.action: Tell me which it is. If it is out of date, I suggest: "Your first-visit offer is the one you agreed with Rihla. You can change it when offer edits arrive with the next update."

needs_you.title: "Covers" here, "Estimated covers" on the demo report
needs_you.detail: The dashboard says "Covers are counted when a scanned diner visits." The demo report shows the same figure as "Estimated covers". Counted and estimated are different promises. The dashboard also has "Redemptions", which the demo report does not show.
needs_you.action: Pick one word for each figure and I will make the dashboard, the demo report and the homepage agree.

changes_intro: Everything below is committed on `claude/practical-keller-adcqrc`. Once loaded, the dashboard looks the same.

changes.title: The footer no longer jumps
changes.why: The dashboard is hidden until the page has checked the login. Until then the page was just the top bar and the footer, so the footer showed near the top and then dropped below the dashboard. The main area now always fills the first screen, so the footer starts out of sight and stays there. Layout shift went from 0.12 to 0.02.
changes.after: main { max-width: 680px; min-height: calc(100vh - 60px); margin: 0 auto; … }

changes.title: Icons and language, as on the homepage
changes.why: Added the `favicon.ico` fallback, the iPhone icon and `theme-color`, set `lang="en-US"`, and marked the two Arabic marks as Arabic. Owners who save the dashboard to their phone's home screen now get the Rihla icon.

changes.title: Same font request as the homepage
changes.why: The page now sends the identical request, so the fonts come from cache for anyone who has seen another page.

changes.title: Taller tap areas
changes.why: "Log out" in the top bar was 18 px tall and the footer links 17 px. They are now 42 px and 29 px to tap. Nothing moved.

changes.title: Google Analytics added, with nothing about the owner
changes.why: A page view of the dashboard is the simplest sign that an owner came back. The tag sends the fixed page title, "Members Area — Rihla", and the page address. The restaurant name and email shown on the page are never sent, and a check confirms it.
changes.after: gtag.js G-1235J90MCS, consent default denied, reads rihla_consent

changes.title: `cta_click` on 9 buttons and links
changes.why: The four tab names show what owners look for first: scans, covers, trust or offers. `members_logout` and `members_demo` show how a visit ends.
changes.after: members_logout · members_tab_scans · members_tab_covers · members_tab_trust · members_tab_offers · members_demo · members_home · footer_email · footer_instagram

changes.why: Comes with `site.js`, which this page now loads. An owner who has already chosen on another page is not asked again.
